text: The council approved the recommendation to increase appropriations in the Special Advertising and Promotion Fund group in the City Manager Department by $6,000 to support the annual Giving Gala 2020 event at the Long Beach Exchange.
The City Manager Department is to use the additional $6,000 for the support of the annual Giving Gala 2020 event at the Long Beach Exchange.
No specific risks were identified in the discussion, though the approval of additional funds involves the usual financial risk associated with event planning.
The council concluded the public hearing and adopted a resolution amending the master fee and charges schedule for standby fire safety officer fees related to special events and filming citywide.
The fire safety officer fees will be revised to provide full cost recovery for staffing costs, with consumables and equipment maintenance costs removed and included in the citywide fee schedule.
There is a potential for increased costs if the revised fee structure does not adequately cover staffing expenses.
